verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own AI product, Visalaw AI, so this axis applies. The firm's first-party page states a 'no data retention' posture, which by default implies client data is not kept for model training. The evidence never explicitly says data is excluded from AI training, and there is no user-facing opt-out control. missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment or opt-out control, policy or terms documentation detailing training use, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Visalaw AI is practice-safe AI: SOC 2 Type II certified, no data retention, and built for confidentiality
